data.title: Elegance Tower
data.about:
Damac Elegance Tower in Downtown Dubai offers beautifully built 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. These apartments, exclusively branded by Zuhair Murad, are one of the most sought-after places in Dubai. The views of the Dubai skyline and the Burj Khalifa are spectacular from here.

With modern designs and high-end luxury, you will be able to live a lifestyle beyond expectations, providing you with the most gratifying experiences. Elegance Tower, which provides a variety of unique services and facilities, has everything you need.

characteristics_module.title: A view as dazzling as a flash
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded by Couture designer Zuhair Murad
  • Located in downtown Burj Khalifa District
  • Ultra-Luxurious apartments
  • 1 to 2 Bedroom apartments available
  • Burj Khalifa and Zabeel park views
  • Starting Price 1.79M AED to 2.34M AED
  • Easy 80/20 Payment Plan

location_tile.title: Downtown Dubai has a New Centerpiece
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: Elegance Tower is located in one of Dubai’s most renowned areas, Downtown Dubai, only a few steps from The Dubai Mall. Residents will have access to major attractions, international fashion labels, and 5-star resorts, in addition to exquisite restaurants and stylish rooftop bars.
